The '''LPL 2023 Summer''' was the 2023 Summer Split of the [[LoL Pro League]] (LPL), organized by TJ Sports in China from May 29 – August 5, 2023. The split featured 17 teams competing in an offline format across multiple cities, including Shanghai, Suzhou, Shenzhen, Xi’an, and Beijing. The Group Stage was held in venues such as the Hongqiao World IE Hub and various team homegrounds, with the Finals taking place at Xi'an Qujiang Sports Arena. The Group Stage used a single round-robin format with best-of-three matches. The top ten teams advanced to the Playoffs, which consisted of a King-of-the-Hill Phase followed by a Double-Elimination bracket, with all playoff matches played as best-of-five. The first and second seeds from the Group Stage received byes to the Semifinals. The split was contested on patch 13.10–13.13, with Ivern and Rell disabled during Weeks 3–4. The tournament had a total prize pool of ¥4,200,000 CNY, and the top teams qualified for the 2023 [[World Championship/2023|Worlds]].

==Format==
* '''Group Stage''' 
** Single round robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** Top 10 advanced to [[LPL/2023/Summer/Playoffs|Playoffs]]
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to Round 2 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''7th till 10th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''11th till 17th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
** Tiebreakers
*** If two or more teams have won the same number of matches, the tie will be broken by the order:
***# Games differential
***# Head-to-head results

* '''Group Stage Side Selection Procedure'''
** The first listed team will pick sides for Game 1, the second listed will pick sides for Game 2.
** If the {{Abbr/Bo3}} series goes to Game 3, the team who won the game in the shorter time will pick the side for Game 3.

* '''Playoffs''' 
** '''''Phase One: King-of-the-Hill'''''
*** 3rd - 10th seeded teams from Group Stage are divided into two brackets to play a King-of-the-Hill format
**** 3rd, 6th, 7th and 10th seed are in one bracket (the first bracket), the other 4 seeds are in the other
**** The winners advance to Phase Two
**** The winner of the first bracket faces 2nd seed team in the Double-Elimination Stage, the other faces the 1st seed
** '''''Phase Two: Double-Elimination'''''
*** Four teams play in a Double-Elimination format to compete for the championship
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}

* '''Free Side Selection Privilege'''
** Before the start of the series, the higher seed team can choose which '''''three''''' games of the {{Abbr/Bo5}} series to pick the side.
** This is only for the first round of the Playoffs ''Phase One''.

* '''Standard Side Selection Procedure'''
** For the upper bracket Finals and lower bracket matches in Playoffs ''Phase Two'', the Side seleciton Privilege will be determined by coin toss. Besides that, the higher seeded teams (in Grand Finals, the upper bracket winner) will have the side selection for game 1 of the series.
** Subsequently, the loser of the previous game will have side selection privilege.
